A debug-mode Valkyrie improvises on a wished wooden flute, wishes for a magic portal, which keeps maketrap()'s dst of {-1, -1}, and steps back onto it, arriving on a level of dungeon -1 (as recipes/mkroom.c/mkundead-cursed-bell-dungeon-minus-one does). She waits out the stun, turns into a dwarf with #polyself, makes a newt with ^G and fights it (F k). The seed, date and character were chosen independently; the seed is the first tried.
